Subject: Thornbury Kitchen Co - Referral Required

Hi Leon,

Thanks for the Thornbury Kitchen Co submission. I've reviewed the information and everything we need is included—appreciate the complete package!

However, this risk requires referral to our senior underwriting team due to:

• One or more locations within 16 km of the coast
• High coastal accumulation in our existing portfolio within 25 km

Before I can move this forward, I need to answer a few questions:

1. Can you provide exact distances from coast for each location?
2. What specific wind mitigation features are in place at the coastal location(s)?
3. Is the insured willing to consider higher wind/hail deductibles?

Given the coastal exposure concentration, you may also want to consider reaching out to a specialty coastal property market for competitive terms.

Happy to discuss further!

[Underwriter name]
